name: Zoom for Claude
description: The Zoom for Claude connector allows users to search their Zoom meetings using natural language, retrieve meeting assets such as AI summaries, docs, recordings, and whiteboards, and access recording-specific resources including transcripts, summaries, next steps, and playback links. Users can ask questions to quickly locate the exact moment a topic was discussed in a meeting recording, generate agendas, capture notes, identify action items, and follow up using the transcript, summary, and shared materials.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zoom for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zoom for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zoom.us/mcp/zoom/streamable. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zoom for Claude MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoom for Claude provides these MCP tools: search_meetings, recordings_list, get_meeting_assets, get_recording_resource, create_new_file_with_markdown, search_zoom, get_file_content, hub_create_file_from_content, and hub_get_file_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zoom for Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zoom for Claude in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Zoom for Claude MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoom for Claude requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zoom for Claude is developed by Zoom. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
